title: GTAGym: Real AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. However, evaluating whether agents can complete tasks in AAA games is challenging and often human-annotated because task outcomes are often difficult to verify automatically, let alone applying it for Reinforcement Learning (RL). We introduce GTAGym, an environment and framework for evaluation and RL on GTA V tasks. Its evaluation benchmark, GTAVBench, derived from GTA V main-story missions, contains 103 online tasks reconstructed across nine task families, alongside 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks using GTA V imagery. A web server provides access to the online environment and evaluation interface, supporting parallel testing through screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions with automatic engine-state outcome checks. translated_title: GTAGym：用于评估与强化学习的真实AAA游戏任务环境
translated_abstract: AAA游戏为评估智能体的感知、推理和控制能力提供了丰富的测试平台。然而，评估智能体能否在AAA游戏中完成任务十分困难，且通常需要人工标注，因为任务结果往往难以自动验证，更难以将其应用于强化学习（RL）。我们提出了GTAGym，一个面向GTA V任务的评估与强化学习环境及框架。其评估基准GTAVBench源自GTA V主线剧情任务，包含跨九个任务类别重建的103个在线任务，以及基于GTA V图像的47个图像式射击与狙击任务。一个网络服务器提供对在线环境和评估界面的访问，通过截图和键盘-鼠标操作支持并行测试，并具备自动的引擎状态结果校验。我们在GTAVBench上使用文本任务指令评估了六个前沿大语言模型，并在其GTAVBench-AGI分支上进行评估，其中指令……
tldr: 本文提出GTAGym——一个基于《侠盗猎车手V》真实AAA游戏任务的评估与强化学习环境，其基准GTAVBench包含103个跨九类任务家族的在线主线任务及47个图像式射击狙击任务，支持截图与键鼠操作的并行测试并自动校验任务结果，用于评测前沿大语言模型的智能体能力。
en_tdlr: GTAGym is an environment and framework for evaluating and training reinforcement learning agents on real AAA game tasks in GTA V, featuring the GTAVBench benchmark with 103 online tasks across nine task families plus 47 image-based shooting and sniping tasks, supporting parallel testing with screenshots and keyboard-mouse actions and automatic engine-state outcome verification for benchmarking frontier LLMs.
